source_document.body:
Interstate 94 ranked first in Trucker Path ’s 2026 assessment of major U.S. trucking corridors, narrowly beating I-90 in truck parking availability, truck stop ratings and diesel prices. I-80 placed third, giving northern routes all three top spots.
What’s Related
Trucker Path scored 19 corridors on a 100-point scale, with I-94 earning 94.20 points, followed by I-90 at 94.05 and I-80 at 93.75. The company gave parking availability more weight than the other measures, describing it as a consistently identified driver concern.
The results, distributed Oct. 28, ranked I-35 and I-15 fourth and fifth. The top 10 also included I-40, I-44, I-20, I-70, and I-45.
The ranking measures conditions at stops along the routes. Its three scoring categories exclude traffic congestion, pavement quality, and travel times, so read the results as a comparison of places to park, refuel , and take a break.
RELATED STORIES: Ranking the Lower 48 States by Truck Parking Availability | The 10 U.S. Cities Where Trucks Park on Ramps Most Often
Parking leader finishes fifth overall
The highest-ranked corridor didn't lead every category. I-94 recorded parking availability of 83.9% and an average truck stop rating of 3.6, compared with 86.1% and 3.8 for second-place I-90.
I-15 had the highest parking availability among the top 10, at 87.3%, but finished fifth overall. Its listed average diesel price was also the highest in that group, at $6.81.
At the other end of the top 10, I-45 had the lowest listed diesel price, at $5.79, and the lowest parking availability, at 75.2%. The difference between its parking figure and I-15’s was 12.1 percentage points.
The top 10 corridors
Trucker Path’s top 10 are listed below. The company's ranking includes parking percentages, truck stop ratings and overall scores.
Rank | Interstate | Parking Availability | Average Truck Stop Rating | Overall Score Out of 100
1 | I-94 | 83.9% | 3.6 | 94.20
2 | I-90 | 86.1% | 3.8 | 94.05
3 | I-80 | 84.6% | 3.7 | 93.75
4 | I-35 | 82.3% | 3.6 | 93.20
5 | I-15 | 87.3% | 3.7 | 92.55
6 | I-40 | 82.8% | 3.5 | 92.00
7 | I-44 | 78.8% | 3.6 | 91.70
8 | I-20 | 80.5% | 3.6 | 91.45
9 | I-70 | 81.4% | 3.6 | 90.60
10 | I-45 | 75.2% | 3.6 | 89.65
Source: Trucker Path, 2026. Overall scores factor in parking availability, truck stop ratings, and fuel prices, with parking availability weighted most heavily.
